recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一顆大型細胞，核為單一圓形、未分葉，胞質灰藍帶顆粒並有突出小泡（bleb），屬單核／低分葉的異常巨核細胞（dysplastic megakaryocyte），支持 MDS 的巨核系發育不良。
features: Large cell (roughly 2-3 times a red cell diameter) with a single round, non-lobated nucleus
Coarsely clumped, reticular chromatin without visible nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm with a peripheral cytoplasmic bleb/budding
Adjacent bare reniform nucleus with similar chromatin and a small lymphocyte
No definite multilobation of the megakaryocyte nucleus in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a large megakaryocytic cell with a single round, non-lobated nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin and grey-blue granular cytoplasm with a cytoplasmic bleb. An adjacent bare reniform nucleus and a small lymphocyte are present. The non-lobated (monolobated) nuclear configuration is a form of dysmegakaryopoiesis. In the appropriate context of a hypocellular marrow with cytopenias, findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia of myelodysplastic syndrome; cellularity cannot be assessed from this single-cell field.

ddx.vs: MDS with isolated del(5q) typically shows many small hypolobated/monolobated megakaryocytes in a normo- to hypercellular marrow, requiring karyotype to separate from other MDS.

ddx.dx: Immature (stage II) megakaryocyte in reactive marrow
ddx.vs: Normal maturing megakaryocytes show progressive lobulation as cytoplasm matures, whereas a mature granular cytoplasm with a still non-lobated nucleus indicates dysplasia.
Aplastic anemia is hypocellular with markedly reduced megakaryocytes but lacks dysplastic megakaryocytes, and blasts or cytogenetic abnormalities favor hypocellular MDS.
Megakaryoblasts have finer chromatin, nucleoli and agranular basophilic cytoplasm, unlike the clumped chromatin and granular cytoplasm here.
